h: The Two Consolations Unite the Upper and Lower Worlds

p: אָנֹכִי אָנֹכִי הוּא מְנַחֶמְכֶם (יְשַׁעְיָה נא, יב)
"I, I am He Who consoles you" (Yeshayahu 51:12).
בַּתִּיקּוּנִים (תִּיקּוּן ל, קח, א; בִּדְפוּס וִילְנָא עד, ב)
In the Tikkunim (Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 30, 108a; Vilna edition 74b):
and the secret of the matter:
'I, I am He Who consoles you'
and about both of them it is said (Devarim 32:39):
that "Anochi — this is the lower Shechinah"
Anochi, is from the side of Keser, etc.;
and in it is Ayin, etc."
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב סד, ב)

so how does he say here of Anochi

from the side of the supernal Mother,
the Exodus from Egypt is mentioned in the Torah,"

there are the letters of "rosh, head,"
which indicate the attribute of Malchus,
because it is known that "Ani, I"
in the midst of the Children of Yisrael."
is literally in the midst of the Children of Yisrael.
but when one says in the form
this indicates the aspect of the Shechinah,
within the heart of the Children of Yisrael.
which is in the Name Ad-nai
And when there is a kaf
in the middle of the word "Ani,"
And this is what is said

from the side of the supernal Mother, etc.";
הַיְינוּ דְּעַל יְדֵי תָּגוֹ שֶׁל יוּד
that is, through the crownlet of the yud
which is the inwardness of Keser Elyon;
and "with wisdom He founded the earth"
with the Father He founded the Daughter,
which is the attribute of Malchus;
And this is what is said
every Jew reads in the Torah,
dwell in the midst of the Children of Yisrael,"

to its including all ten sefiros,
And this is what he said:
'I, I am He Who consoles you,'"
along the lines of what is said

"'I, I am He Who wipes away,' etc. (Yeshayahu 43:25)
that He created the world, etc.,
alludes to the attribute of Malchus,
and "once" at the creation of the world
as is written in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 48):
who makes for them a dwelling
in the two chambers of the heart."
in the midst of the Children of Yisrael,
Only, the lower Shabbos is such
the yetzer hara can return again;
which is the aspect of the upper Shechinah
this indicates that one is redeemed entirely,
so that the yetzer hara will never again
And this is what is said
the yetzer hara was uprooted from their hearts
(as is found in Midrash Shir HaShirim);
the yetzer hara came back and returned to its place.
"And once at the time He created the world"
like Adam HaRishon before the corruption,
when Adam HaRishon was in Gan Eden;
and then the whole world was so,
which is not so at Sinai,
where it was only in Yisrael,
in the ultimate completeness in every respect,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קעז, ב)
as is said in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 177b):
He is called the One Who is hidden
the One Who does not appear to the eye;
the One Who is not called by a name."
And this is what is said
between the upper and lower Shechinah;
that the yetzer hara will not return
For at the time of Creation,
even though there was no yetzer hara,
And this is what is said (Shabbos 118b):
they will merit a second Shabbos,
and whoever merits, on one Shabbos,
And this is what is said
"And about both of them it is said:

the Cause above all the supernal ones,
the Cause above all causes, etc.;
and indeed I did not tell you
except that there is one who is called
and not the One Who is called
the Cause above all causes, etc."
And this will be in the future:
And in this world, on Shabbos,
that is a semblance of the World to Come,
and it is the level of
with the kaf in the middle,

for there is a revelation on Shabbos

and there is no god with Me";

And this is what it says afterward:
"Who are you that you are afraid

"And if this is how You deal with me."
